stem.text: The graph shows the variation of displacement with distance for two progressive waves $X$ and $Y$ of the same type in the same medium.

stem.alt: Graph of displacement in cm against distance in cm, on a grid. A solid curve labelled wave X and a dashed curve labelled wave Y are both drawn. Displacement axis from −1.0 to 1.0 cm. Distance axis from 0 to 14 cm.

stem.text: The intensity of wave X is $I$.
